closure: Source-only installed-state implementation: audio_stream.rs owns 0x6ec1bc/0x6ec418 and message_request_send 0x6e2b80; audio_packet_ring.rs owns the original 900-slot ring; audio_stream_pipeline.rs owns 0x6e59e8/0x6e5590/0x6e51f0 plus shared physical completion and cancellation phase control; audio_stream_installed.rs implements Pipeline/PipelineLifecycle for host and ARM over original installed FFF020 handle/MMIO and resource/controller state; audio_stream_pipeline_native.rs supplies physical-effect adapters; shared audio_stream_construction.rs owns original generation-table acquisition and resource configuration, with physical adapters in audio_stream_construction_native.rs. Vendor service admission/configuration and canonical Display composition remain integration dependencies, not runtime ownership evidence.

source_evidence.completion_lifecycle: Host and ARM call the same stream_pipeline::complete(PipelineLifecycle,Completion) and cancel(PipelineLifecycle,EventHandle). PipelineLifecycle extends Pipeline with stop, release, finished and nested guard effects. Physical completion publishes before phase reset; cancellation publishes after phase reset. Failed transmit update keeps error4 across later stop/release failures. Source app/drivers/audio/transfer_cancel_phase.h and tu_006e4af8.c.
source_evidence.native_dma: app/drivers/isp/fff020_channel_initialization.{c,h}: installed state0x918b98, handles+0x40, IRQtokens+0x60. Original generation comparisons and states are retained. Registration snapshots the selected owned receive/send handler through xm1_power_timer_irq_attach, source38.
source_evidence.installed_provider: stream_installed::InstalledPipeline<ConstructionMemory,InstalledIo> is the canonical host/ARM implementation of program/start/status/close and resource start/stop/release CPU. InstalledIo extends ConstructionIo with IRQ mask, typed IRQ registration/release, cache clean, semaphore signal and canonical callback/executor effects. NativePipeline delegates to this provider. Tests exercise actual channel1 register images, controller direction gates, shared installed handles, IRQ failure partial state and drain release; no private host DMA lease substitutes for those fields.

Resource progress/error flags and failed constructor partial state are retained.

source_evidence.construction_api: stream_construction::{controller_acquire,resource_acquire,resource_configure,pipeline_acquire,resource_release} run the same installed-address CPU for host and ARM. ConstructionMemory provides typed Address word/halfword/byte access; native overrides each access width with the corresponding volatile scalar operation. ConstructionIo provides nested guard and typed semaphore wait effects. Native exports keep their ABI and reside under stream_construction::native. Behavioral tests read actual shared-generation, DMA/controller state, resource flags and MMIO images, including failed-acquisition partial state.

boundaries.channel_index_residue: The first-program path ignores the channel-index read status and consumes its output residue on invalid handles. The native submit ABI requires that residue explicitly; the continuation path does not consult it. No replacement zero result is synthesized at the read boundary.
boundaries.bank_record_residue: Only the first8bytes of the76byte publication record are initialized by0x6e97c0. audio_bank_residue.S retains the source frame offset and passes the complete physical record to Rust; the68byte suffix is not zero-filled.
